summary: Implemented OCR-3: OCR text is a bounded, whitespace-normalized search target alongside title and tags, and OCR text/confidence/engineVersion/updatedAt are explicitly preserved through .ndcase manifest export and copy/replace import, with pre-write rejection of invalid or unknown OCR metadata. Verified with 15 focused real-fflate/fake-indexeddb tests, the full 811-test suite, typecheck, lint, formatting, and coverage above the 85% floor for src/domain and src/data.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented OCR-3: OCR text is a bounded, whitespace-normalized search target alongside title and tags, and OCR text/confidence/engineVersion/updatedAt are explicitly preserved through .ndcase manifest export and copy/replace import, with pre-write rejection of invalid or unknown OCR metadata. Verified with 15 focused real-fflate/fake-indexeddb tests, the full 811-test suite, typecheck, lint, formatting, and coverage above the 85% floor for src/domain and src/data.
decisions: OCR fields remain optional members of the existing v1 card schema; no database migration or archive format-version bump was introduced.
Search collapses whitespace in query and OCR text before matching and caps the snippet body at 160 characters.
Export and import compare the four OCR fields explicitly and fail rather than silently dropping them; import rejects invalid OCR metadata before opening the write transaction.
interfaces: searchCards exports OCR_SNIPPET_MAX_LENGTH and normalizes whitespace in queries and OCR text; ocrSnippet stays string | null.
archiveFormat exports ARCHIVE_CARD_OCR_FIELDS, ArchiveCardOcrField, ArchiveCardOcr, readArchiveCardOcr, archiveCardOcrEquals, and assertArchiveCardOcrPreserved.
buildCaseArchive, importCase, restoreValidatedCaseArchive, and CaseArchiveManifest are unchanged.

warnings: Archive formatVersion remains 1; an older build whose card schema predates OCR would reject archives containing OCR fields. Release documentation should record this compatibility decision.
When a future OCR field is added, ARCHIVE_CARD_OCR_FIELDS must be updated or the new field will not be guarded by export/import comparisons.
validationLimitations: No new browser journey was run; search/archive behavior is validated with pure selectors and real fflate archives over fake-indexeddb, while OCR-2 already covers the visible OCR flow.
payload.taskDescription: Update searchCards to match stored OCR text and return a snippet, and update the archive manifest and export/import paths to include OCR text, confidence, engineVersion, and updatedAt. Add tests proving OCR text is searchable without changing card data, survives export/import in both copy and replace modes, and is absent safely when no OCR has run. Do not add new OCR engine behavior or UI.
